neighbours.label: the final suffix piece of a split word in a classification predicate ("is considered hydr|ating", "classified as a pollut|ant")
fire: Coffee is not usually considered dehydrating by doctors.
Carbon monoxide is classified as a toxicant in most countries.
Small scratches on the lens are not regarded as defects.
Lead is considered a contaminant in drinking water.
Some grasses are classified as invasives in this state.
Vinegar is considered an effective disinfectant for counters.
Mild flavours are considered appetizing by most children.
Sulfur dioxide is listed as an irritant for the lungs.
quiet: Coffee is not usually considered bad by doctors.
Carbon monoxide is classified as a gas in most countries.
Small scratches on the lens are not regarded as bad.
Lead is considered a metal in drinking water.
Some grasses are classified as weeds in this state.
Vinegar is considered a good cleaner for counters.
Mild flavours are considered nice by most children.
